footer.tagline: Intelligent travel planning designed for families. Discover destinations, plan itineraries, and create unforgettable memories together.
footer.stack: FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Amadeus · Groq AI · Google Places

home.subtitle: Discover the perfect destination for your family. From Disneyland Paris for the kids to cultural gems for everyone — planned around your budget and dates.
home.featuresSubtitle: More than a search engine — a complete travel intelligence platform built for families.
home.feature1Desc: Hybrid engine — rule-based scoring plus real Groq AI reasoning — scores destinations by child age, budget, season, and family interests.
home.feature2Desc: Find cheaper dates, accommodations, and alternative destinations that fit your wallet.
home.feature3Desc: Auto-generated travel plans with age-appropriate activities and AI-written narratives for every day.
home.feature4Desc: Saved once in your family profile, reused everywhere — no re-entering ages or interests.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Four simple steps to your perfect family trip
home.step1Desc: Ages, interests, and travel preferences — once
home.step2Desc: We find the best fit for your schedule
home.step3Desc: Ranked destinations with real AI explanations
home.exampleDesc: Our engine recommends <1>Paris & Disneyland Paris</1> — matching the child's age, summer season, and your family budget.
